visual.prompt: 什么是视觉模型与多模态？ What Are Vision & Multimodal Models?
视觉模型 = 像素翻译官

text: 简单来说，它是像素世界的“翻译官”。

visual.prompt: A friendly 3D cartoon robot wearing glasses, holding a magnifying glass over a glowing pixel grid that transforms into a cat silhouette, bright clean tech lab background, high quality 3D realistic cartoon style, cinematic lighting, 4k

text: 在计算机眼中，图片并非风景，而是一堆冰冷的数字矩阵。

visual.prompt: Animated zoom into a photo → dissolves into RGB number grid (e.g., 255,0,0 / 0,128,64), with floating 'pixel' labels and binary pulses; clean vector aesthetic

text: 视觉模型的任务，就是从这些杂乱数字中抽丝剥茧。
无论是CNN，还是Transformer，都通过多层网络过滤，从线条、边缘，进化到识别形状与物体。

visual.prompt: Side-by-side animated layer progression: left shows CNN kernel sliding + edge detection → shape → object; right shows Transformer attention heatmap focusing on cat ears then whole cat; smooth transitions, labeled layers

text: 最终，它会笃定地告诉你：‘嘿，这堆数字代表的是一只猫。’

visual.prompt: A 3D cartoon cat suddenly emerges from a swirling pixel cloud, then winks and sits confidently on a glowing neural network diagram, smooth reveal animation, high quality 3D realistic cartoon style, cinematic lighting
visual.fallback: ai_image::A confident 3D cartoon cat sitting on a glowing neural net diagram, pixel-to-cat transformation effect, bright clean studio lighting, high quality 3D realistic cartoon style, cinematic lighting, 4k

text: 提到多模态，绕不开CV与NLP这两座大山。
语言模型负责‘听话’与‘对话’，CV则要让AI真正‘看见’世界。

visual.prompt: Split-screen animation: left shows speech bubbles + text flowing into LLM brain icon; right shows camera lens focusing on photo → image features → ‘eye’ icon lighting up; icons sync pulse

text: 算力爆发催生了VLM——视觉语言模型，也就是多模态模型。
过去AI是各司其职的‘偏科生’；多模态AI则打通了视觉与语言的任督二脉。

visual.prompt: Two cartoon AI characters: left is a ‘text-only’ robot with ear but no eyes, right is ‘vision-only’ robot with eyes but no mouth; center shows unified AI with both eyes and mouth glowing, connected by golden neural bridge, vibrant tech background, high quality 3D realistic cartoon style
核心优势 = 跨模态理解

text: 它不再孤立处理像素，而是深刻理解画面与文字间的内在逻辑。

visual.prompt: Animated bidirectional arrow between photo and caption box; arrow pulses with ‘semantic link’ label; photo morphs to sketch → to text → to emoji → back to photo, seamless loop

text: 它能由图生文、视觉问答、甚至文生图。
丢给它一张风景照，它能瞬间生成朋友圈文案。
你问‘穿红衣服的人在干什么？’它能精准捕捉细节并作答。
你只需一句指令，它便能凭空构想出一幅画作。

visual.prompt: A 3D cartoon artist typing ‘sunset over mountain lake’ on a holographic keyboard; words float up and transform into a vivid landscape painting in mid-air, brushstroke animation, warm cinematic lighting, high quality 3D realistic cartoon style
visual.fallback: ai_image::A 3D cartoon artist creating a sunset mountain lake painting from floating text words, holographic interface, warm golden hour lighting, high quality 3D realistic cartoon style, cinematic lighting, 4k

text: 视觉模型给了AI眼睛，语言模型给了AI嘴巴。

visual.prompt: 眼睛 + 嘴巴 = 感知闭环

text: 多模态模型，让AI进化成‘有眼有嘴、能看能说’的完整体。

visual.prompt: A single confident 3D cartoon AI humanoid with glowing eyes and speaking mouth, standing atop a fused vision+language symbol (eye + speech bubble merged), radiant light beam rising, futuristic studio backdrop, high quality 3D realistic cartoon style, cinematic lighting, 4k

text: 既然AI已具备观察与表达能力，我们该如何精准指挥它？这就引出了AI时代的‘通用编程语言’——提示词。
